title: 门店净销售、利润与目标达成
learningObjective: 独立计算门店净额、毛利及目标达成率，避免多粒度连接造成重复。
concept: 净销售是扣除折扣、退款后的有效销售额；毛利为净销售减退货冲减后成本，不是扣除租金等费用的净利润。金额使用整数分。目标和订单明细不是同一粒度，须先预聚合。
syntax: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0) gross_cents,ROUND(100.0*(a.net-a.cost)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) margin_pct,b.target target_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.target,0),2) achievement_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY net_cents DESC

parameters.金额: 整数马币分；比率按题设

executionSteps: 按门店汇总销售与成本
useCase: 区域经理核对2025年有效线下订单，退款截至年底并归属原订单日期；每门店一行，无销售门店保留。净额和目标为零时分别不计算对应比率。
comparison: 毛利率衡量盈利结构，目标达成率衡量计划完成；不能互换。

commonError.example: 直接连接目标月表与订单明细后求和。
commonError.correction: 先将各事实表聚合到门店粒度再连接；保留缺目标与零目标的区别。

notes: 完整输出见 ../enterprise_reference/business_tasks/results/BP01.json；公开预览展示前12行。独立边界及场景仅在提交判题时使用。

mergedFrom.title: 门店净销售、利润与目标达成

teaching.problem: 区域经理核对2025年有效线下订单，退款截至年底并归属原订单日期；每门店一行，无销售门店保留。净额和目标为零时分别不计算对应比率。
teaching.codeExplanation: 原查询的 sales lines 视图已处理有效订单及退款，因此不能再次减退款。a 汇总净额与成本，b 汇总同期目标，两个结果均为一店一行。主档左连接保证无销售门店仍存在。分母分别为净额和目标；先计算再舍入。示例第一店净额10000、成本6000，目标12500。若要诊断类别贡献，在销售层按门店和类别分组，不能将门店目标复制到各类别。
teaching.resultExplanation: 小型示例门店1毛利4000、毛利率40%、目标达成80%；门店2达成100%、毛利率30%；门店3无销售且目标为零，两种比率均未定义。原企业预览门店1达成9.7%、毛利率39.88%；仅提示偏差，不能单凭此判断管理失误。

checkpoints.name: a
checkpoints.label: 按门店汇总净销售与成本
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id)
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;

checkpoints.name: b
checkpoints.label: 按门店合并月度目标
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id)
SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 3;

mergedConcepts.explanation: 门店类别销售拆分：按门店×类别汇总有效净额，门店目标不能直接分配到类别。
净销售及毛利口径：2025有效线下订单、退款归属原订单日期、截止年底，成本同步冲回。

mergeExamples.label: 小型示例：独立汇总销售
mergeExamples.explanation: 内联的四笔明细含一笔线上订单，排除后按门店聚合。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH stores AS (SELECT 1 store_id UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3),
v_sales_lines AS (SELECT 1 store_id, '2025-01-03' order_date, 'store' channel, 1 category_id, 8000 net_cents, 5000 cost_cents UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02-03','store',2,2000,1000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02-05','online',1,9000,4000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-01-04','store',1,5000,3500),
sales_targets AS (SELECT 1 store_id,'2025-01' month_key,5000 target_cents UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02',7500 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-01',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 3,'2025-01',0),
a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id),
b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY net;

mergeExamples.label: 小型示例：汇总目标
mergeExamples.explanation: 门店1两个月目标相加，而不是乘上订单数。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH stores AS (SELECT 1 store_id UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3),
v_sales_lines AS (SELECT 1 store_id, '2025-01-03' order_date, 'store' channel, 1 category_id, 8000 net_cents, 5000 cost_cents UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02-03','store',2,2000,1000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02-05','online',1,9000,4000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-01-04','store',1,5000,3500),
sales_targets AS (SELECT 1 store_id,'2025-01' month_key,5000 target_cents UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02',7500 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-01',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 3,'2025-01',0),
a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id),
b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY target;

mergeExamples.label: 小型示例：完整门店查询
mergeExamples.explanation: 左连接两份汇总并计算指标。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH stores AS (SELECT 1 store_id UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3),
v_sales_lines AS (SELECT 1 store_id, '2025-01-03' order_date, 'store' channel, 1 category_id, 8000 net_cents, 5000 cost_cents UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02-03','store',2,2000,1000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02-05','online',1,9000,4000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-01-04','store',1,5000,3500),
sales_targets AS (SELECT 1 store_id,'2025-01' month_key,5000 target_cents UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02',7500 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-01',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 3,'2025-01',0),
a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id),
b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0) gross_cents,ROUND(100.0*(a.net-a.cost)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) margin_pct,b.target target_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.target,0),2) achievement_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY net_cents;

mergeExamples.label: 小型示例：类别拆分
mergeExamples.explanation: 只拆销售，避免复制目标。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH stores AS (SELECT 1 store_id UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3),
v_sales_lines AS (SELECT 1 store_id, '2025-01-03' order_date, 'store' channel, 1 category_id, 8000 net_cents, 5000 cost_cents UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02-03','store',2,2000,1000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02-05','online',1,9000,4000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-01-04','store',1,5000,3500),
sales_targets AS (SELECT 1 store_id,'2025-01' month_key,5000 target_cents UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02',7500 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-01',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 3,'2025-01',0),
a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id),
b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT store_id,category_id,SUM(net_cents) AS net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,category_id ORDER BY net DESC;
